privileged_info_for_vlm: The database is Oracle (localhost:1521/XEPDB1, user: hr). The view name must be SLA_PERFORMANCE_VW. Business hours are 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri. Key test cases: Ticket 1001 (Fri 16:00 to Mon 10:00) should result in 120 business minutes. Ticket 1002 (Fri 16:30 to Tue 09:30 with Mon as holiday) should result in 60 business minutes. Ticket 1003 (Tue 20:00 to Wed 09:15) should result in 15 business minutes. SLA_STATUS is 'MET' if BUSINESS_MINUTES <= 480.
